subject: Installation of amber18 on on parallel CPU

messages.author: Dulal Mondal
messages.body:
Dear Users,
I have installed amber 18. I also have tested parallely in cpu. I found 205
file comparisons passed,5 file comparisons failed (4 of which can be
ignored) and 0 tests experienced errors and in amber tools parallel tests I
found 1016 file comparisons passed, 2 file comparisons failed (0 ignored),
2 tests experienced errors. Respective files are attached below.
Thanking you
With regards,
Dulal Mondal
